definitions.explanation: The activity of visiting and looking at places of interest.

notes:
{見物|けんぶつ} means sightseeing or watching, depending on context.

VERBAL USAGE:
{見物|けんぶつ}する is the verbal form (to go sightseeing, to watch).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- Xを{見物|けんぶつ}する: to go see X (sightseeing)
- Xの{見物|けんぶつ}に{行|い}く: to go watch X (event)
- {見物|けんぶつ}{客|きゃく}/{見物人|けんぶつにん}: spectators, onlookers

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {桜|さくら}を{見物|けんぶつ}する: to view cherry blossoms
- {祭|まつ}りを{見物|けんぶつ}する: to watch a festival
- {名所|めいしょ}を{見物|けんぶつ}する: to visit famous places

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {観光|かんこう}: tourism (more general)
- {観覧|かんらん}: viewing (more formal)
